responsibility: Primary language-hook implementation for the GNU Modula-2 front end inside GCC. This file defines the gm2 lang_hooks table and associated front-end callbacks for option initialization/handling, file parsing entry, tree and type support, gimplification of Modula-2-specific nodes such as TRY_BLOCK and HANDLER, exception personality selection, conversions, addressability, and size/mode type mapping, thereby owning the interface between gm2’s front end and GCC’s generic parsing, tree, EH, and gimplification infrastructure.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the gm2 language-hook interface: it defines the lang_hooks table and the executable hook/callback bodies, whereas gm2-lang.h only exposes the declarations that other gcc/m2 files include.
